crossRefs.note: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples…
Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was; because you have taken your great…
Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled.…
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire…
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”
So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out…
He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.
At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth trembles; and the cry is heard among the nations.
The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy…

translations.web: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
translations.bsb: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
translations.kjv: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
translations.asv: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth above the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
